remarks:
Room to spread out and space to grow at 160 Fowler! This five bedroom, three full bath home offers an eat in kitchen, a separate dining room, and both a living room and family room, giving you flexibility for everyday living and entertaining. Two staircases add character and convenience. Recent updates include new windows, refinished hardwood floors and new luxury vinyl plank flooring in the kitchen and hallway in 2025, plus updated light fixtures. All bedrooms are on the second floor along with two full baths. One full bathroom was completely remodeled in 2025, while the second-floor full bath is well maintained. The basement has an additional room and another full bathroom as well as laundry and storage area.
Outside, backyard drain tile was added and the patio refreshed in 2026, creating a welcoming spot to relax or gather. A spacious home with thoughtful updates and plenty of room to make it your own!

Showings will start at Open house on Saturday, October 10th 11am. Open house 10/10 11am-1pm and Tuesday 10/13 5pm-7pm. Negotiations will begin on Monday 10/19@4pm.
